name: gitlab_get_note
method: GetIssueNoteAsync / GetMergeRequestNoteAsync / GetSnippetNoteAsync / GetVulnerabilityNoteAsync / GetProjectWikiPageNoteAsync / GetEpicNoteAsync / GetGroupWikiPageNoteAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Fetch one specific note by its numeric id once its parent and id are known.

name: gitlab_add_note
method: CreateIssueNoteAsync / CreateMergeRequestNoteAsync / CreateSnippetNoteAsync / CreateVulnerabilityNoteAsync / CreateProjectWikiPageNoteAsync / CreateEpicNoteAsync / CreateGroupWikiPageNoteAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Post a stand-alone comment on an issue, merge request, snippet, vulnerability, wiki page or epic.

name: gitlab_delete_note
method: DeleteIssueNoteAsync / DeleteMergeRequestNoteAsync / DeleteSnippetNoteAsync / DeleteVulnerabilityNoteAsync / DeleteProjectWikiPageNoteAsync / DeleteEpicNoteAsync / DeleteGroupWikiPageNoteAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Permanently remove a note.

name: gitlab_resolve_discussion
method: ResolveForIssueAsync / ResolveForMergeRequestAsync / ResolveForEpicAsync (dispatched by noteable_type; commit/snippet rejected client-side - GitLab has no such route)
purpose: Mark a whole discussion thread resolved or reopen it, on the three noteable types GitLab supports for thread-level resolve.

name: gitlab_reply_to_discussion
method: AddNoteToIssueDiscussionAsync / AddNoteToMergeRequestDiscussionAsync / AddNoteToCommitDiscussionAsync / AddNoteToSnippetDiscussionAsync / AddNoteToEpicDiscussionAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Add a reply note into an existing discussion thread instead of starting a new one.

name: gitlab_get_discussion_note
method: GetNoteInIssueDiscussionAsync / GetNoteInMergeRequestDiscussionAsync / GetNoteInCommitDiscussionAsync / GetNoteInSnippetDiscussionAsync / GetNoteInEpicDiscussionAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Read a single reply note inside a discussion thread by id.

name: gitlab_update_discussion_note
method: UpdateNoteInIssueDiscussionAsync / UpdateNoteInMergeRequestDiscussionAsync / UpdateNoteInCommitDiscussionAsync / UpdateNoteInSnippetDiscussionAsync / UpdateNoteInEpicDiscussionAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Rewrite the body of a reply note inside a discussion thread.

name: gitlab_resolve_discussion_note
purpose: Resolve or unresolve a single diff note inside a merge request discussion (note-level resolve exists only for merge requests; GitLab 403s on non-resolvable notes).

name: gitlab_delete_discussion_note
method: DeleteNoteFromIssueDiscussionAsync / DeleteNoteFromMergeRequestDiscussionAsync / DeleteNoteFromCommitDiscussionAsync / DeleteNoteFromSnippetDiscussionAsync / DeleteNoteFromEpicDiscussionAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
purpose: Delete a single reply note from inside a discussion thread.

name: gitlab_remove_reaction
method: DeleteFromIssueAsync / DeleteFromIssueNoteAsync / DeleteFromMergeRequestAsync / DeleteFromMergeRequestNoteAsync / DeleteFromSnippetAsync / DeleteFromSnippetNoteAsync / DeleteFromEpicAsync / DeleteFromEpicNoteAsync (dispatched by target_type)
purpose: Remove one of the caller's own emoji reactions (GitLab 403s on anyone else's reaction).

name: gitlab_get_draft_note
purpose: Read one pending draft note by id.

name: gitlab_update_draft_note
purpose: Rewrite the text of a pending draft note before it is published.

name: gitlab_delete_draft_note
purpose: Discard a pending draft note without ever publishing it.

name: gitlab_publish_draft_note
purpose: Publish a single pending draft note, turning it into a visible comment (irreversible).

name: gitlab_publish_all_draft_notes
purpose: Submit the whole pending review as one event: publish every draft note, optionally set a reviewer state and post a summary comment.

name: gitlab_apply_suggestions_batch
purpose: Apply several code suggestions together as a single commit.

name: gitlab_list_my_merge_requests
purpose: List merge requests scoped to the caller across the whole instance (assigned to me, created by me, or awaiting my review) -- the 'what's on my plate' query.

name: gitlab_get_merge_request
purpose: Fetch one merge request's full detail by project and iid.

name: gitlab_merge_merge_request
purpose: Merge a merge request (optionally squashing, or setting a custom merge commit message); irreversible through the API.

name: gitlab_delete_merge_request
purpose: Permanently delete a merge request outright -- not the same as closing it.

name: gitlab_rebase_merge_request
purpose: Queue a rebase of the source branch onto the target branch to resolve conflicts; rewrites source-branch history.

name: gitlab_cancel_merge_when_pipeline_succeeds
purpose: Cancel a previously scheduled auto-merge-on-green-pipeline for a merge request.

name: gitlab_get_merge_request_diff
purpose: Get the per-file diffs of a merge request, bounded by limit, for code review without pulling the whole raw patch.

name: gitlab_run_merge_request_pipeline
purpose: Trigger a new CI pipeline run for a merge request, e.g. to retry after fixing a failure.

name: gitlab_delete_approval_rule
purpose: Delete a project's standing approval rule. Project scope only -- the API exposes no group-rule delete.

name: gitlab_get_issue
purpose: Fetch one issue by project and its project-scoped IID.

name: gitlab_get_issue_by_global_id
purpose: Fetch one issue when only its instance-wide global id is known (webhooks, search results, cross-project references), not the project+iid pair.

name: gitlab_list_issues
purpose: List and filter a project's issues by state, labels, milestone title, assignee, weight, search text, or date range, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_list_my_issues
purpose: List issues visible to the authenticated user across every project; defaults to authored, widen with the scope filter (assigned_to_me / all).

name: gitlab_close_issue
purpose: Close an issue.

name: gitlab_reopen_issue
purpose: Reopen a closed issue.

name: gitlab_delete_issue
purpose: Permanently delete an issue. Requires owner/administrator rights on the token; prefer closing for ordinary workflow.

name: gitlab_move_issue
purpose: Move an issue to a different project; it is relocated under a new IID and the original is redirected, not copied.

name: gitlab_clone_issue
purpose: Copy an issue into another project, optionally including its notes, leaving the original issue in place.

name: gitlab_link_issues
purpose: Create a relation between this issue and another (possibly in a different project): relates_to, blocks, or is_blocked_by.

name: gitlab_unlink_issues
purpose: Remove a relation between two issues by its link id.

name: gitlab_get_issue_time_stats
purpose: Get the time-tracking totals (estimate and time spent, human-readable and raw) for an issue.

name: gitlab_manage_issue_time
purpose: Adjust an issue's time tracking in one action-based tool: set or clear the estimate, or log or clear spent time. Clearing discards recorded values irreversibly.

name: gitlab_get_issue_statistics
purpose: Count issues by state (opened/closed/all) at instance, group, or project scope, using the same filters as list_issues.

name: gitlab_list_issue_related_merge_requests
purpose: List merge requests that mention this issue, optionally narrowed (closing_only) to just the ones that will close it on merge.

name: gitlab_list_milestones
purpose: List a project's or group's milestones, filterable by state, title, or search text.

name: gitlab_get_milestone
purpose: Get one milestone by its numeric id (not iid) at project or group scope.

name: gitlab_update_milestone
purpose: Update a milestone's title, description, dates, or close/reopen it.

name: gitlab_delete_milestone
purpose: Permanently delete a milestone.

name: gitlab_promote_milestone
purpose: Promote a project milestone to group scope, moving every issue and merge request assignment with it. Irreversible.

name: gitlab_list_milestone_merge_requests
purpose: List every merge request assigned to a milestone.

name: gitlab_update_label
purpose: Rename, recolor, redescribe, or archive a label.

name: gitlab_delete_label
purpose: Permanently delete a label.

name: gitlab_promote_label
purpose: Promote a project label to group scope, moving every issue/MR assignment with it. Irreversible; fails if the project has no parent group.

name: gitlab_get_board
purpose: Get one issue board, including its lists, at project or group scope.

name: gitlab_update_board
purpose: Rename a board or toggle its backlog/closed-list visibility.

name: gitlab_delete_board
purpose: Permanently delete an issue board.

name: gitlab_create_board_list
purpose: Create a board list scoped to exactly one of: a label, a milestone, an iteration, or an assignee.

name: gitlab_reorder_board_list
purpose: Move a board list to a new position among its siblings.

name: gitlab_delete_board_list
purpose: Permanently delete a board list.

name: gitlab_mark_todo_done
purpose: Mark a single to-do item done. Irreversible through this API — there is no 'mark pending' endpoint.

name: gitlab_mark_all_todos_done
purpose: Mark every pending to-do item done in one call. Irreversible.

name: gitlab_set_merge_request_subscription
purpose: Subscribe or unsubscribe the authenticated user to a merge request's notifications.

name: gitlab_set_label_subscription
purpose: Subscribe or unsubscribe the authenticated user to a project or group label's notifications.

name: gitlab_get_resource_group
purpose: Get a resource group's process mode plus which job currently holds it and which jobs are queued behind it, in one read.

name: gitlab_list_repository_tree
purpose: Browse files and directories at a given ref to locate a path before reading or editing it.

name: gitlab_get_file_content
purpose: Read a file's text content (decoded from Base64) plus size/blob-id/last-commit metadata at a branch, tag or SHA.

name: gitlab_update_file
purpose: Replace an existing file's content and commit the change.

name: gitlab_delete_file
purpose: Delete a file and commit its removal from a branch.

name: gitlab_list_commits
purpose: List a project's commit history, optionally scoped to a branch/tag and a date range.

name: gitlab_get_commit
purpose: Fetch one commit's message, author and stats by SHA, branch or tag name.

name: gitlab_get_commit_diff
purpose: See the per-file diff a single commit introduced.

name: gitlab_cherry_pick_commit
purpose: Apply an existing commit onto another branch.

name: gitlab_revert_commit
purpose: Create a commit that undoes another commit's changes on a branch.

name: gitlab_comment_on_commit
purpose: Leave a comment on a commit, optionally anchored to a specific diff line.

name: gitlab_list_commit_merge_requests
purpose: Find which merge request(s) a given commit landed through, for traceability from a hotfix or cherry-pick.

name: gitlab_get_branch
purpose: Fetch one branch's head commit and coarse protection flags.

name: gitlab_delete_branch
purpose: Delete a single branch.

name: gitlab_delete_merged_branches
purpose: Bulk-clean every branch already merged into the project's default branch.

name: gitlab_delete_tag
purpose: Delete a tag.

name: gitlab_compare_refs
purpose: Full diff and commit list between two branches, tags or commits — e.g. what a merge would bring in.

name: gitlab_set_commit_status
purpose: Report or update a build/check status against a commit from an external CI integration.

name: gitlab_unprotect_branch
purpose: Remove protection from a branch or wildcard pattern.

name: gitlab_unprotect_tag
purpose: Remove protection from a tag or wildcard pattern.

name: gitlab_create_push_rule
purpose: Add a project's first push rule (fails if one already exists).

name: gitlab_update_push_rule
purpose: Change an existing project push rule.

name: gitlab_list_push_mirrors
purpose: List a project's configured push mirrors and their sync status.

name: gitlab_create_push_mirror
purpose: Configure a new push mirror replicating the repository to an external remote.

name: gitlab_get_member
purpose: Get one project or group member by user id, optionally looking through inherited/invited-group membership.

name: gitlab_add_member
purpose: Add a user, by id or username, to a project or group at a given access level.

name: gitlab_update_member
purpose: Change a member's access level, expiry date, or custom member role.

name: gitlab_remove_member
purpose: Remove a direct member from a project or group; group removal can cascade to subgroups/projects and free a billable seat.

name: gitlab_list_pending_group_members
purpose: List a top-level group's memberships awaiting approval, including email invitees with no GitLab account yet.

name: gitlab_approve_pending_group_members
purpose: Approve one pending group membership by its membership id, or every pending membership at once.

name: gitlab_set_group_member_ldap_override
purpose: Flag or clear a member's LDAP-sync override so the next synchronisation does or doesn't touch their access level.

name: gitlab_create_member_role
purpose: Create a custom member role (instance, group, or admin-role scope) layering chosen abilities on a base access level.

name: gitlab_delete_member_role
purpose: Delete a custom member role by id (instance, group, or admin-role scope).

name: gitlab_request_access
purpose: Request access to a project or group as the authenticated user.

name: gitlab_review_access_request
purpose: Approve a pending access request at a chosen access level (turning the requester into a member) or deny it.

name: gitlab_list_invitations
purpose: List a project's or group's pending, directly-made invitations.

name: gitlab_update_invitation
purpose: Change a pending invitation's access level, expiry, or member role, addressed by the invited email.

name: gitlab_delete_invitation
purpose: Revoke a pending project or group invitation by email.

name: gitlab_list_saml_group_links
purpose: List every SAML group link on a group, or get one by name.

name: gitlab_create_saml_group_link
purpose: Grant members of a named SAML group a role in a GitLab group.

name: gitlab_delete_saml_group_link
purpose: Remove a SAML group link; existing members keep access until their next SAML sign-in.

name: gitlab_list_group_provider_identities
purpose: List, or get one by external UID, the SAML or SCIM identities linked to a group's members.

name: gitlab_manage_group_provider_identity
purpose: Re-point a SAML or SCIM identity at a new external UID, or delete it to unlink (and, for SCIM, potentially block) the user.

name: gitlab_get_notification_settings
purpose: Get the caller's notification level and per-event flags, globally or for a specific group or project.

name: gitlab_update_notification_settings
purpose: Update the caller's notification level and per-event flags, globally or for a specific group or project.

name: gitlab_get_current_user
purpose: Get the account the configured token belongs to, optionally with its badge counters (assigned issues/MRs, pending todos).

name: gitlab_manage_current_user_email
purpose: List, add, or delete the caller's secondary email addresses.

name: gitlab_manage_current_user_preferences
purpose: Read or update the caller's diff-viewing and CI-identity preference flags.

name: gitlab_manage_current_user_status
purpose: Read, replace, or amend the caller's profile status (emoji, message, availability, auto-clear time).

name: gitlab_manage_current_user_support_pin
purpose: Read the caller's current GitLab Support PIN, or create a new one valid for seven days; treat the PIN as a secret.

name: gitlab_get_user
purpose: Look up any user by numeric id.

name: gitlab_list_users
purpose: Search or filter users visible to the caller, bounded by limit; several filters are honoured for administrators only.

name: gitlab_manage_user
purpose: Create a new user account, or update an existing one by id (a partial update — unset fields are left alone).

name: gitlab_delete_user
purpose: Delete a user account; hard-delete additionally removes their contributions and solely-owned groups and is not reversible — check associations first.

name: gitlab_set_user_account_state
purpose: Move a user account through its lifecycle — activate, deactivate, block, unblock, ban, unban, approve a pending sign-up, reject one, or disable two-factor auth — as a single administrative action.

name: gitlab_set_user_follow
purpose: Follow or unfollow another user as the caller.

name: gitlab_get_user_status
purpose: Get a user's profile status (emoji, message, availability) by numeric id or username.

name: gitlab_list_personal_access_tokens
purpose: List personal access tokens — administrators see every token on the instance, everyone else only their own.

name: gitlab_get_personal_access_token
purpose: Get one personal access token by id, or the token that authenticated the call.

name: gitlab_create_personal_access_token
purpose: Create a personal access token for the caller (scopes limited to k8s_proxy/self_rotate) or, as an admin, for another user; the plaintext token is shown only in this response.

name: gitlab_rotate_personal_access_token
purpose: Rotate a personal access token, or the token that authenticated the call; the old token is revoked immediately and the new plaintext secret is returned once.

name: gitlab_revoke_personal_access_token
purpose: Revoke a personal access token by id, or the token that authenticated the call.

name: gitlab_revoke_impersonation_token
purpose: Revoke a user's impersonation token.

name: gitlab_get_resource_access_token
purpose: Get one project or group access token by id.

name: gitlab_rotate_resource_access_token
purpose: Rotate a project or group access token by id, or rotate the token that authenticated the call.

name: gitlab_revoke_resource_access_token
purpose: Revoke a project or group access token by id.

name: gitlab_list_service_account_access_tokens
purpose: List the personal access tokens belonging to a project's or group's service account.

name: gitlab_manage_service_account_access_token
purpose: Create, rotate, or revoke a personal access token for a project's or group's service account.

name: gitlab_list_group_credential_inventory
purpose: List personal access tokens, resource access tokens, or SSH keys belonging to a group's enterprise users, for a security audit across the whole hierarchy.

name: gitlab_manage_group_credential
purpose: Revoke or rotate a personal access token, resource access token, or SSH key belonging to one of a group's enterprise users.

name: gitlab_get_ssh_key
purpose: Get one SSH key by id — the caller's, another user's, or, as an admin, by the key's own instance-wide id including its owner.

name: gitlab_add_ssh_key
purpose: Add an SSH public key to the caller's account, or, as an admin, to another user's.

name: gitlab_delete_ssh_key
purpose: Remove an SSH key from the caller's account, or, as an admin, from another user's.

name: gitlab_find_ssh_key_owner
purpose: Resolve an SSH key fingerprint (MD5 or SHA-256) to the user that owns it.

name: gitlab_manage_group_ssh_certificates
purpose: List, register, or remove a group's trusted SSH certificate authorities.

name: gitlab_list_gpg_keys
purpose: List the caller's GPG keys, or another user's.

name: gitlab_add_gpg_key
purpose: Add a GPG public key to the caller's account, or, as an admin, to another user's.

name: gitlab_manage_gpg_key
purpose: Delete or revoke a GPG key from the caller's account, or, as an admin, from another user's; revoking also marks every commit signed with it as unverified.

name: gitlab_get_service_account
purpose: Get one service account owned by a group or project, by its user id.

name: gitlab_manage_service_account
purpose: Create a service account at instance, group, or project scope, or update its name, username, or email.

name: gitlab_delete_service_account
purpose: Delete a group- or project-owned service account, optionally hard-deleting its contributions.

name: gitlab_get_project
purpose: Fetch one project's full details by numeric id or namespaced path.

name: gitlab_list_projects
purpose: Search/browse projects visible to the token, filtered by visibility, search text, ownership or membership; bounded list.

name: gitlab_create_project
purpose: Create a project in the caller's namespace or a named one; with an owner_user_id (admin), creates it for another user via CreateForUserAsync.

name: gitlab_update_project
purpose: Update project settings (description, visibility, merge/CI behavior); optionally replaces the avatar via SetAvatarAsync in the same call.

name: gitlab_delete_project
purpose: Delete a project, or schedule delayed deletion depending on instance settings.

name: gitlab_restore_project
purpose: Undo a pending scheduled project deletion before the delay window elapses.

name: gitlab_set_project_archived
purpose: Archive (read-only) or unarchive a project, dispatching to ArchiveAsync/UnarchiveAsync from a single archived:bool.

name: gitlab_set_project_starred
purpose: Star or unstar a project as the authenticated user, dispatching to StarAsync/UnstarAsync.

name: gitlab_fork_project
purpose: Fork a project into the caller's own namespace or a specified target namespace/name/path.

name: gitlab_transfer_project
purpose: Move a project to a different namespace; if no target namespace is given, lists candidate namespaces via ListTransferLocationsAsync instead of transferring.

name: gitlab_share_project_with_group
purpose: Grant a group access to a project, or revoke it (UnshareAsync) when no access level is supplied.

name: gitlab_list_project_related_groups
purpose: List a project's ancestor groups, the groups it's shared with, or share candidates, selected by a relation parameter (also wraps ListInvitedGroupsAsync/ListShareLocationsAsync).

name: gitlab_list_project_members
purpose: List users associated with a project (members plus, on public projects, everyone @mentionable) for autocomplete-style lookups.

name: gitlab_get_project_insights
purpose: Combine repository fetch statistics, language breakdown (GetLanguagesAsync), and for admins the Gitaly storage location (GetStorageAsync) into one project health snapshot.

name: gitlab_manage_project_security_settings
purpose: Read a project's security settings, or apply changes (secret push protection, pre-receive secret detection) via UpdateSecuritySettingsAsync when a patch is supplied.

name: gitlab_list_user_projects
purpose: List projects a given user owns, has starred, or has contributed to, selected by a relation parameter (also wraps ListStarredByUserAsync/ListContributedByUserAsync).

name: gitlab_get_group
purpose: Fetch one group's details by numeric id or full path.

name: gitlab_list_groups
purpose: Search/browse groups visible to the token.

name: gitlab_update_group
purpose: Update group settings; optionally replaces the avatar via SetAvatarAsync in the same call.

name: gitlab_delete_group
purpose: Schedule a group, and everything under it, for deletion.

name: gitlab_restore_group
purpose: Cancel a pending group deletion.

name: gitlab_set_group_archived
purpose: Archive or unarchive a group, dispatching to ArchiveAsync/UnarchiveAsync from a single archived:bool.

name: gitlab_list_subgroups
purpose: List a group's direct child subgroups, or its whole subtree at any depth when recursive is requested (wraps ListDescendantGroupsAsync).

name: gitlab_move_project_into_group
purpose: Move an existing project into this group (distinct from gitlab_transfer_project, which moves a project to an arbitrary namespace path).

name: gitlab_set_group_share
purpose: Grant another group access to this group's resources, or revoke it (UnshareAsync) when no access level is supplied.

name: gitlab_transfer_group
purpose: Move a group under a new parent, or promote it to top-level; if no target is given, lists candidate parents via ListTransferLocationsAsync instead of transferring.

name: gitlab_get_group_issue_statistics
purpose: Count a group's issues by state over the same filter vocabulary as gitlab_list_group_issues.

name: gitlab_list_group_special_users
purpose: List a top-level group's billable-seat holders, SAML/SCIM-provisioned accounts, or SAML-identity users, selected by a kind parameter (wraps ListProvisionedUsersAsync/ListSamlUsersAsync).

name: gitlab_get_group_audit_event
purpose: Fetch one entry from a group's audit log by its id (no list endpoint exists on this client for groups).

name: gitlab_update_group_security_settings
purpose: Update a group's security settings, such as secret push protection.

name: gitlab_upload_project_file
purpose: Upload a file to a project's markdown attachment store and get back the pastable markdown snippet.

name: gitlab_download_project_upload
purpose: Download a project upload by numeric id, or by the secret+filename scraped from a markdown link (wraps DownloadBySecretAsync).

name: gitlab_get_namespace
purpose: Fetch one namespace (group or personal) by numeric id or URL-encoded full path.

name: gitlab_list_namespaces
purpose: List namespaces visible to the caller (every namespace for an admin, else just their own).

name: gitlab_get_namespace_subscription
purpose: Read the GitLab subscription plan, usage and billing details for a namespace.

name: gitlab_set_namespace_storage_limit_exclusion
purpose: Exclude a namespace from storage-limit enforcement, or remove an existing exclusion (DeleteStorageLimitExclusionAsync) when no reason is supplied.

name: gitlab_get_project_alias
purpose: Fetch one project alias by its name.

name: gitlab_delete_project_alias
purpose: Delete a project alias by name; the project it pointed at is untouched.

name: gitlab_get_topic
purpose: Fetch one topic by its numeric id.

name: gitlab_upsert_topic
purpose: Create a new topic, or update an existing one's title/description/avatar when a topic id is supplied (wraps UpdateAsync/SetAvatarAsync); administrators only.

name: gitlab_merge_topics
purpose: Merge a duplicate topic into another: every project on the source moves to the target and the source topic is deleted.

name: gitlab_get_badge
purpose: Fetch one project or group badge by id (wraps GetForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_update_badge
purpose: Update a project or group badge's link URL, image URL or name (wraps UpdateForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_delete_badge
purpose: Remove a project or group badge (wraps DeleteForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_get_custom_attribute
purpose: Read one custom attribute by key from a user, group, or project (wraps GetForUserAsync/GetForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_delete_custom_attribute
purpose: Delete a custom attribute from a user, group, or project (wraps DeleteForUserAsync/DeleteForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_download_avatar
purpose: Download a project's or group's avatar image, selected by entity_type (wraps DownloadForGroupAsync).

name: gitlab_create_storage_move
purpose: Schedule a repository-storage move for one project, one group's wiki, or one snippet, selected by entity_type (wraps CreateForGroupAsync/CreateForSnippetAsync); self-managed instances only.

name: gitlab_create_organization
purpose: Create a top-level organization (GitLab 17.5+, still experimental), optionally with an avatar attached.

name: gitlab_delete_organization
purpose: Soft-delete an organization; no restore endpoint exists yet.

name: gitlab_list_pipelines
purpose: List a project's pipelines with status/ref/branch filters, bounded by limit, to see recent CI activity.

name: gitlab_get_pipeline
purpose: Get one pipeline's full status, timing and metadata by id.

name: gitlab_cancel_pipeline
purpose: Cancel all running or pending jobs in a pipeline.

name: gitlab_retry_pipeline
purpose: Retry a pipeline's failed and canceled jobs without re-running successful ones.

name: gitlab_delete_pipeline
purpose: Permanently delete a pipeline and all its jobs, logs, artifacts and triggers; requires Owner role.

name: gitlab_get_latest_pipeline
purpose: Get the most recent pipeline for a branch or tag (default branch if ref omitted) — the 'is main green' check.

name: gitlab_rename_pipeline
purpose: Set a pipeline's display name.

name: gitlab_get_pipeline_test_report
purpose: Get a pipeline's test results rolled up per suite; optionally also fetch GetTestReportAsync and include a bounded list of failed/error cases for debugging.

name: gitlab_list_pipeline_variables
purpose: List the CI/CD variables a specific pipeline actually ran with, for debugging a build.

name: gitlab_get_job
purpose: Get one job's full status, timing and commit/pipeline linkage.

name: gitlab_retry_job
purpose: Re-run a finished (failed or canceled) job as a new job.

name: gitlab_play_job
purpose: Start a manual job that is waiting to be triggered.

name: gitlab_erase_job
purpose: Irreversibly erase a job's log and artifacts, e.g. to remove leaked secrets from a build log.

name: gitlab_get_job_log
purpose: Fetch a job's console log, tailed and size-bounded, to diagnose a CI failure without opening the GitLab UI.

name: gitlab_list_pipeline_schedules
purpose: List a project's cron-scheduled pipelines.

name: gitlab_get_pipeline_schedule
purpose: Get one pipeline schedule's cron, ref, owner and last-triggered pipeline.

name: gitlab_update_pipeline_schedule
purpose: Change a pipeline schedule's description, ref, cron or active flag.

name: gitlab_delete_pipeline_schedule
purpose: Permanently delete a pipeline schedule.

name: gitlab_run_pipeline_schedule
purpose: Trigger a scheduled pipeline immediately, out of band of its cron.

name: gitlab_take_pipeline_schedule_ownership
purpose: Make the calling user the schedule's owner so future runs use their permissions.

name: gitlab_get_pipeline_schedule_variable
purpose: Read one CI/CD variable attached to a pipeline schedule, by key (there is no list-all endpoint).

name: gitlab_create_pipeline_schedule_variable
purpose: Add a CI/CD variable visible only to pipelines this schedule triggers.

name: gitlab_update_pipeline_schedule_variable
purpose: Change a pipeline schedule variable's value or type (the key itself is immutable).

name: gitlab_delete_pipeline_schedule_variable
purpose: Remove a variable from a pipeline schedule.

name: gitlab_get_trigger
purpose: Get one pipeline trigger token's metadata by id.

name: gitlab_update_trigger
purpose: Rename a trigger token's description (the token value itself is immutable).

name: gitlab_delete_trigger
purpose: Revoke a pipeline trigger token.

name: gitlab_trigger_pipeline
purpose: Fire a new pipeline using a trigger or CI job token supplied by the caller (also covers TriggerPipelineForRefAsync when a branch/tag ref is given), with extra variables.

name: gitlab_get_ci_variable
purpose: Read one project or group CI/CD variable by key (also covers GetGroupVariableAsync); an environment scope disambiguates a repeated project key.

name: gitlab_update_ci_variable
purpose: Change an existing project or group CI/CD variable's value or flags (also covers UpdateGroupVariableAsync).

name: gitlab_delete_ci_variable
purpose: Delete a project or group CI/CD variable (also covers DeleteGroupVariableAsync).

name: gitlab_list_instance_variables
purpose: List every instance-wide CI/CD variable; administrator token required.

name: gitlab_get_instance_variable
purpose: Read one instance-level CI/CD variable by key.

name: gitlab_create_instance_variable
purpose: Create an instance-wide CI/CD variable available to every project's pipelines.

name: gitlab_update_instance_variable
purpose: Change an instance-level CI/CD variable's value or flags.

name: gitlab_delete_instance_variable
purpose: Delete an instance-level CI/CD variable.

name: gitlab_download_job_artifacts
purpose: Fetch a job's whole artifacts archive, or the latest run of a named job on a ref via DownloadForRefAsync, as a downloadable file.

name: gitlab_get_job_artifact_file
purpose: Fetch one file out of a job's artifacts archive, such as a coverage report, without downloading the whole archive; also covers DownloadFileForRefAsync by branch/tag.

name: gitlab_keep_job_artifacts
purpose: Exempt a job's artifacts from expiry so they are not auto-deleted.

name: gitlab_delete_job_artifacts
purpose: Delete one job's artifacts immediately.

name: gitlab_publish_ci_catalog_version
purpose: Publish a new version of a CI/CD component project to the CI/CD Catalog.

name: gitlab_get_job_token_scope
purpose: Check whether a project restricts which other projects or groups can authenticate with its CI job token.

name: gitlab_set_job_token_scope
purpose: Turn a project's CI job token access restriction on or off.

name: gitlab_add_job_token_allowlist_entry
purpose: Grant another project or group access via this project's CI job token (also covers AddGroupToAllowlistAsync).

name: gitlab_remove_job_token_allowlist_entry
purpose: Revoke a project or group's access via this project's CI job token (also covers RemoveGroupFromAllowlistAsync).

name: gitlab_list_packages
purpose: Browse every package a project holds across all 12 formats (npm, NuGet, Maven, Conan, PyPI, Debian, RubyGems, Composer, Golang, Generic, Helm, TerraformModule) with name/version/type/status filters — the primary package-registry discovery tool.

name: gitlab_get_package
purpose: Get one package's full detail (version, status, creator, publishing pipeline) by its numeric id, regardless of format.

name: gitlab_list_package_files
purpose: List the individual files (with checksums and size) that make up one package version, to inspect what was actually published.

name: gitlab_delete_package_file
purpose: Remove one file from a package while leaving the package and its other files in place — e.g. dropping a stray or oversized artifact without deleting the whole version.

name: gitlab_list_package_pipelines
purpose: Trace a published package back to the CI pipeline(s) that built it, newest first — provenance/audit for a given package.

name: gitlab_upload_generic_package_file
purpose: Publish a build artifact (binary, archive, report) into a project's generic package registry under a package name/version/filename — the file-drop path CI or an agent uses when no dedicated package-manager format applies.

name: gitlab_download_generic_package_file
purpose: Fetch a previously published generic package file's bytes back out, bounded by size, e.g. to inspect a release artifact.

name: gitlab_list_group_container_repositories
purpose: List every container repository across all projects in a group — an org-wide image inventory.

name: gitlab_get_container_repository
purpose: Get one container repository's detail (location, size, tag count) by its own global id, when the caller already knows the repository id rather than the project.

name: gitlab_list_container_repository_tags
purpose: List the tags pushed to one container repository, to see what versions of an image exist before deciding what to clean up or deploy.

name: gitlab_get_container_repository_tag
purpose: Get one image tag's full detail — digest, total size, revision — e.g. to confirm exactly which build a tag points at before promoting or deleting it.

name: gitlab_delete_container_repository_tag
purpose: Delete one named image tag from a repository, e.g. removing a bad or leaked build.

name: gitlab_delete_container_repository_tags
purpose: Bulk-delete image tags on a repository matching a name regex, a keep-newest-N count, or an age threshold — the ad hoc equivalent of running a registry cleanup policy on demand.

name: gitlab_purge_dependency_proxy_cache
purpose: Schedule deletion of every cached upstream image/package manifest and blob in a group's dependency proxy — e.g. forcing a refetch after an upstream image was fixed or replaced. Requires the Owner role on the group.

name: gitlab_update_package_protection_rule
purpose: Change an existing package protection rule's name pattern, format or required access level; unset fields keep their current value.

name: gitlab_delete_package_protection_rule
purpose: Remove a package protection rule, lifting the push/delete restriction it enforced.

name: gitlab_update_container_registry_protection_rule
purpose: Change an existing container repository protection rule's path pattern or required access levels.

name: gitlab_delete_container_registry_protection_rule
purpose: Remove a container repository protection rule.

name: gitlab_list_container_registry_protection_tag_rules
purpose: List a project's container image tag protection rules — which tag name patterns (e.g. 'v*', 'prod') only Maintainer+/Owner+ may push or delete.

name: gitlab_create_container_registry_protection_tag_rule
purpose: Protect an image tag name pattern (e.g. 'release-*') so only roles at or above chosen push/delete levels can overwrite or remove matching tags. Both access levels are required — there is no unrestricted default for tags.

name: gitlab_update_container_registry_protection_tag_rule
purpose: Change an existing image tag protection rule's pattern or required access levels.

name: gitlab_delete_container_registry_protection_tag_rule
purpose: Remove an image tag protection rule.

name: gitlab_get_debian_distribution
purpose: Get one project Debian distribution's full configuration by codename (suite, origin, retention, components, architectures).

name: gitlab_create_debian_distribution
purpose: Set up a new Debian (APT) distribution/codename on a project so packages can be published to it. Only the codename is required.

name: gitlab_update_debian_distribution
purpose: Change a Debian distribution's suite, origin, label, description, retention window, components or architectures. The codename itself cannot be changed.

name: gitlab_delete_debian_distribution
purpose: Remove a Debian distribution from a project, scheduling deletion of its packages and index files.

name: gitlab_get_debian_distribution_key
purpose: Retrieve a Debian distribution's signing-key metadata, e.g. to hand an apt client the public key it needs to trust the repository.

name: gitlab_list_group_debian_distributions
purpose: List Debian (APT) distributions configured at group scope, shared across the group's projects.

name: gitlab_get_group_debian_distribution
purpose: Get one group-scoped Debian distribution's configuration by codename.

name: gitlab_get_terraform_module
purpose: Look up the latest published version of a Terraform module by its group namespace, name and provider system — 'what does our module registry currently publish for aws/vpc'.

name: gitlab_get_terraform_module_version
purpose: Get the full metadata (submodules, provider dependencies, source) for one specific published version of a Terraform module.

name: gitlab_search_projects
purpose: Search for projects by name/description across the instance, or narrow to one group (SearchGroupProjectsAsync) or leave both project/group unset for instance-wide (SearchProjectsAsync); bounded, projected list.

name: gitlab_search_issues
purpose: Full-text issue search, scoped to instance, one group (SearchGroupIssuesAsync) or one project (SearchProjectIssuesAsync) via an optional project/group parameter.

name: gitlab_search_merge_requests
purpose: Full-text MR search, scoped to instance, one group (SearchGroupMergeRequestsAsync) or one project (SearchProjectMergeRequestsAsync).

name: gitlab_search_users
purpose: Find users by name/username/email, instance-wide or scoped to a group (SearchGroupUsersAsync) or project (SearchProjectUsersAsync) — e.g. to resolve an assignee.

name: gitlab_search_milestones
purpose: Search milestone titles/descriptions within one group or project (SearchProjectMilestonesAsync) — no instance-wide milestone search exists in GitLab.

name: gitlab_search_notes
purpose: Search comment text within one group or project (SearchProjectNotesAsync) — no instance-wide note search exists.

name: gitlab_search_commits
purpose: Search commit messages within one group or project (SearchProjectCommitsAsync) — no instance-wide commit search exists.

name: gitlab_search_semantic_code
purpose: Meaning-based (not keyword) code search within one project's indexed repository; requires semantic code search enabled and indexed for the project. Not a paginated stream — returns one ranked result set.

name: gitlab_get_search_migration
purpose: Get one advanced-search migration's status by version or name. Admin token required.

name: gitlab_get_wiki_page
purpose: Read one wiki page's content by slug, optionally at a historical revision, from a project or group wiki.

name: gitlab_update_wiki_page
purpose: Update an existing wiki page's title, content or format by slug, in a project's or group's wiki.

name: gitlab_delete_wiki_page
purpose: Permanently delete one wiki page by slug from a project or group wiki.

name: gitlab_upload_wiki_attachment
purpose: Upload a file into a project's or group's wiki uploads directory and get back ready-to-paste markdown to embed it in a page.

name: gitlab_list_snippets
purpose: List the caller's own snippets, or every snippet on one project when a project is given (ListForProjectAsync).

name: gitlab_list_public_snippets
purpose: List every public snippet visible to the caller across the instance, for discovering shared code examples.

name: gitlab_get_snippet
purpose: Get one snippet's metadata and file list by id (personal or project, shared id space; pass project to disambiguate a project snippet via GetForProjectAsync).

name: gitlab_update_snippet
purpose: Update a personal or (with project given) project snippet's title, description, content or files.

name: gitlab_delete_snippet
purpose: Permanently delete a personal or (with project given) project snippet.

name: gitlab_get_snippet_content
purpose: Download a single-file snippet's raw text content (buffered and truncated server-side before returning), personal or project-scoped.

name: gitlab_get_snippet_file_content
purpose: Download one named file's raw text content from a multi-file snippet at a given ref, personal or project-scoped.

name: gitlab_get_snippet_user_agent_detail
purpose: Get the recorded user-agent/IP/spam-check details for a snippet, for abuse investigation. Administrator only.

name: gitlab_list_templates
purpose: List the instance's built-in Dockerfile, .gitignore (ListGitignoresAsync) or CI/CD YAML (ListCiYmlsAsync) templates by key/name, selected via a kind parameter.

name: gitlab_get_template
purpose: Get the full body of one Dockerfile, .gitignore (GetGitignoreAsync) or CI/CD YAML (GetCiYmlAsync) template by name, selected via a kind parameter — for scaffolding a new project or pipeline.

name: gitlab_get_license_template
purpose: Get one license's full text by key (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0), optionally with the [project] and [fullname] placeholders filled in for direct use in a new repository.

name: gitlab_get_group_activity_summary
purpose: Get a group's recent-activity snapshot in one call — issues created, merge requests created and new members added — combining GetGroupActivityIssuesCountAsync, GetGroupActivityMergeRequestsCountAsync and GetGroupActivityNewMembersCountAsync.

name: gitlab_list_deployment_frequency
purpose: Stream a project's deployment-frequency time series for one environment over a date range, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_get_dora_metrics
purpose: Get a DORA metric time series (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, time to restore service, or change failure rate) for a group or project (GetProjectDoraMetricsAsync), parsed from the raw JSON into dated value points.

name: gitlab_list_code_search_shards
purpose: List every Zoekt exact-code-search node configured on this self-managed instance, for capacity/health checks.

name: gitlab_remove_code_search_indexed_namespace
purpose: Remove a namespace from a Zoekt node's exact-code-search index, dropping its search index for that node.

name: gitlab_update_code_search_namespace_replicas
purpose: Override how many index replicas a namespace gets in Zoekt exact-code-search, for scaling search capacity.

name: gitlab_trigger_code_search_indexing
purpose: Trigger a fresh Zoekt exact-code-search reindex of one project and get back the background job id to track it.

name: gitlab_enable_knowledge_graph_namespace
purpose: Enable GitLab Duo Knowledge Graph for a namespace by numeric id or path.

name: gitlab_list_active_context_connections
purpose: List every ActiveContext (Duo agentic indexing) connection configured on this instance and which one is active.

name: gitlab_activate_active_context_connection
purpose: Activate an ActiveContext connection; this deactivates and drops the indexed data of whichever connection was previously active, so treat as irreversible.

name: gitlab_deactivate_active_context_connection
purpose: Deactivate an ActiveContext connection (or the currently active one if none specified); asynchronously drops its indexed data and deletes its record.

name: gitlab_update_active_context_namespace_state
purpose: Transition a namespace's ActiveContext code-indexing state between pending and ready, e.g. to force a re-sync.

name: gitlab_clear_active_context_dead_queue
purpose: Permanently discard every item stuck in the ActiveContext dead-letter queue.

name: gitlab_replay_active_context_dead_queue
purpose: Re-enqueue dead-lettered ActiveContext queue items into another queue for reprocessing, as a recovery action.

name: gitlab_get_terraform_state
purpose: Read a named Terraform state's current document (or, when a serial is given, a specific historical version via DownloadVersionAsync) so a DevOps user can inspect live infrastructure state.

name: gitlab_upload_terraform_state
purpose: Publish a new Terraform state document as the project's current state (creates it or appends a new version) — the write half of Terraform's HTTP backend.

name: gitlab_delete_terraform_state
purpose: Permanently delete a named Terraform state and every historical version of it.

name: gitlab_delete_terraform_state_version
purpose: Delete one historical version (by serial number) of a Terraform state, leaving the current state in place — e.g. pruning old versions.

name: gitlab_lock_terraform_state
purpose: Place a lock on a Terraform state so no other run can write it, mirroring Terraform's own LOCK protocol.

name: gitlab_unlock_terraform_state
purpose: Release a Terraform state lock, or force-unlock it by omitting the lock id when a crashed run left it stuck.

name: gitlab_update_terraform_state_protection_rule
purpose: Change an existing Terraform state protection rule's access level or allowed-from scope.

name: gitlab_delete_terraform_state_protection_rule
purpose: Remove a Terraform state protection rule, reverting that state to the project's default write access.

name: gitlab_list_cluster_agents
purpose: List the Kubernetes agents registered for a project.

name: gitlab_get_cluster_agent
purpose: Get one cluster agent's registration details, including which config project defines it.

name: gitlab_register_cluster_agent
purpose: Register a new GitLab agent for Kubernetes on a project by name.

name: gitlab_delete_cluster_agent
purpose: Deregister a cluster agent, disconnecting the Kubernetes agent process running with its identity.

name: gitlab_revoke_cluster_agent_token
purpose: Revoke a cluster agent token immediately, disconnecting any running agent still using it.

name: gitlab_get_cluster_agent_url_configuration
purpose: Read the receptive-mode URL configuration (address and TLS material) GitLab uses to connect out to an agent, if one is set (GitLab 17.4+, zero-or-one per agent).

name: gitlab_create_cluster_agent_url_configuration
purpose: Configure a receptive agent's connection address and TLS material so GitLab can reach it directly (GitLab 17.4+).

name: gitlab_delete_cluster_agent_url_configuration
purpose: Remove a cluster agent's receptive-mode URL configuration.

name: gitlab_export_dependencies
purpose: Kick off an asynchronous dependency-list or SBOM export scoped to a project, group, or single pipeline (also wraps CreateGroupExportAsync / CreatePipelineExportAsync by scope); poll gitlab_get_dependency_export_status then gitlab_download_dependency_export.

name: gitlab_get_dependency_export_status
purpose: Check whether a requested dependency-list export has finished generating.

name: gitlab_download_dependency_export
purpose: Download a finished dependency-list or SBOM export file.

name: gitlab_list_dependency_occurrence_vulnerabilities
purpose: List the vulnerabilities associated with one specific dependency occurrence, for drilling down from a dependency list entry.

name: gitlab_list_dependency_attestations
purpose: List the provenance attestations recorded for one build artifact hash (GitLab feature-flags this, calling it not yet production-ready).

name: gitlab_scan_file_for_vulnerabilities
purpose: Run a real-time SAST scan on a single file's content without a full pipeline, for a quick pre-commit check; GitLab marks this endpoint experimental with no fixed response schema.

name: gitlab_upload_sbom_scan
purpose: Submit a CI job's software bill of materials for vulnerability scanning, checking it against the instance's size limit first via AuthorizeSbomScanUploadAsync.

name: gitlab_get_sbom_scan
purpose: Look up an SBOM scan's results, or its still-running state, by the digest of the uploaded document.

name: gitlab_reuse_sbom_scan
purpose: Attach an existing scan's results to a new job instead of re-uploading and re-scanning an identical SBOM digest.

name: gitlab_delete_error_tracking_client_key
purpose: Revoke a client key, returning it as it looked just before deletion so the caller can confirm which one was removed.

name: gitlab_get_error_tracking_settings
purpose: Check whether error tracking is enabled for a project and whether it's integrated (GitLab-hosted) or pointed at external Sentry.

name: gitlab_create_error_tracking_settings
purpose: Turn on error tracking for a project for the first time, choosing integrated vs. external Sentry mode.

name: gitlab_update_error_tracking_settings
purpose: Toggle error tracking on/off, or switch between integrated and external Sentry mode, on an already-configured project.

name: gitlab_list_alert_metric_images
purpose: List the metric screenshots/graphs attached to an alert, to review the evidence behind an incident.

name: gitlab_upload_alert_metric_image
purpose: Attach a metric image to an alert, optionally linking to more detail elsewhere (e.g. an external dashboard) with a caption.

name: gitlab_update_alert_metric_image
purpose: Change a metric image's caption or linked-detail URL without re-uploading the image file (there is no endpoint to replace the file itself).

name: gitlab_delete_alert_metric_image
purpose: Remove a metric image from an alert.

name: gitlab_list_runners
purpose: List runners visible to the caller, or scoped to one project/group via an optional id, to find a runner by tag/status before assigning work or debugging CI capacity. Also covers ListProjectRunnersAsync/ListGroupRunnersAsync.

name: gitlab_get_runner
purpose: Get one runner's full configuration and status by id, e.g. to confirm tags or online state before diagnosing a stuck pipeline.

name: gitlab_delete_runner
purpose: Permanently remove a runner from the instance.

name: gitlab_assign_runner_to_project
purpose: Grant an existing shared/project runner to another project so its pipelines can use it.

name: gitlab_unassign_runner_from_project
purpose: Revoke a project's access to a runner it doesn't own (fails with a validation error if aimed at the runner's own owner project - delete it instead).

name: gitlab_list_runner_jobs
purpose: See what a runner is processing or has processed, to diagnose load or find which runner picked up a specific job.

name: gitlab_list_runner_managers
purpose: List the machines (managers) registered behind one runner registration, each with its own version and last-contact time.

name: gitlab_list_runner_projects
purpose: List the projects a project-scoped runner is assigned to, to audit or prune its reach.

name: gitlab_reset_runner_registration_token
purpose: Rotate the runner registration token for the instance, a project, or a group when it may have leaked; the new token is shown exactly once. Also covers ResetProjectRegistrationTokenAsync/ResetGroupRegistrationTokenAsync.

name: gitlab_reset_runner_authentication_token
purpose: Force every manager currently connected under a runner to re-authenticate by issuing it a fresh authentication token, shown exactly once.

name: gitlab_list_runner_controllers
purpose: List the runner-controller fleet-management agents registered on the instance (admin only).

name: gitlab_get_runner_controller
purpose: Get one runner controller's details, including whether it is currently connected (a flag list does not report).

name: gitlab_register_runner_controller
purpose: Register a new runner controller; it starts with no scope and no usable token, both must be set up afterward.

name: gitlab_update_runner_controller
purpose: Rename a runner controller or change its enabled/disabled/dry-run state.

name: gitlab_delete_runner_controller
purpose: Permanently delete a runner controller.

name: gitlab_assign_runner_controller_scope
purpose: Put a controller in charge of the whole instance, or (given a runner id) of one runner. Also covers AddRunnerScopeAsync; fails with a conflict if the controller already holds the other kind of scope.

name: gitlab_remove_runner_controller_scope
purpose: Take a controller out of charge of the instance, or (given a runner id) of one runner. Also covers RemoveRunnerScopeAsync.

name: gitlab_list_runner_controller_tokens
purpose: List a controller's tokens by metadata only (also covers looking up a single one by id); secrets are never listed.

name: gitlab_rotate_runner_controller_token
purpose: Mint a fresh secret for a controller token, invalidating the old one; the secret is shown exactly once.

name: gitlab_revoke_runner_controller_token
purpose: Immediately revoke a controller token so any controller still using it stops authenticating.

name: gitlab_list_environments
purpose: List a project's environments, optionally filtered by name/search/state, to see what's deployed where.

name: gitlab_get_environment
purpose: Get one environment's external URL, tier and current state.

name: gitlab_update_environment
purpose: Change an environment's external URL, tier, Kubernetes namespace or other configuration.

name: gitlab_stop_environment
purpose: Stop an environment, running its on_stop action; an optional force flag stops it even when no stop action is defined (the two-overload pair).

name: gitlab_delete_environment
purpose: Permanently delete an environment record.

name: gitlab_stop_stale_environments
purpose: Bulk-stop every environment last modified or deployed to before a cutoff date, skipping protected environments.

name: gitlab_delete_stale_review_apps
purpose: Schedule stopped review-app environments for deletion a week out; GitLab defaults to a dry run unless explicitly told to execute, and the preview list is not returned by this call.

name: gitlab_list_deployments
purpose: List a project's deployments, filterable by environment, status or date range, to see recent shipping activity.

name: gitlab_get_deployment
purpose: Get one deployment's full details including its triggering job and any pending approvals.

name: gitlab_create_deployment
purpose: Record a deployment performed outside GitLab CI/CD against an environment.

name: gitlab_update_deployment_status
purpose: Move a deployment to a new status such as success, failed or canceled.

name: gitlab_delete_deployment
purpose: Delete a finished deployment that is not the current one for its environment (GitLab refuses otherwise).

name: gitlab_approve_deployment
purpose: Approve or reject a deployment that is blocked on a protected environment's approval rules.

name: gitlab_list_protected_environments
purpose: List the protected environments (project scope) or protected deployment tiers (group scope) configured.

name: gitlab_get_protected_environment
purpose: Get one protected environment's deploy-access entries and approval rules by name (or deployment tier for a group).

name: gitlab_protect_environment
purpose: Protect an environment or deployment tier, naming who may deploy to it and who must approve.

name: gitlab_update_protected_environment
purpose: Change the deploy-access entries or approval rules of an already-protected environment or deployment tier.

name: gitlab_unprotect_environment
purpose: Remove protection from an environment or deployment tier, leaving the environment itself in place.

name: gitlab_list_freeze_periods
purpose: List a project's deployment freeze windows.

name: gitlab_get_freeze_period
purpose: Get one freeze period's cron start/end boundaries and time zone.

name: gitlab_create_freeze_period
purpose: Define a new deploy freeze window with cron start/end expressions, e.g. to block releases over a holiday.

name: gitlab_update_freeze_period
purpose: Change a freeze period's boundaries or time zone.

name: gitlab_delete_freeze_period
purpose: Remove a freeze period, immediately lifting the freeze it described.

name: gitlab_list_releases
purpose: List a project's releases, newest released-at first.

name: gitlab_get_release
purpose: Get one release's notes, milestones, assets and evidence by its Git tag.

name: gitlab_update_release
purpose: Edit an existing release's name, notes, release date or linked milestones.

name: gitlab_delete_release
purpose: Delete a release, leaving its underlying Git tag in place.

name: gitlab_generate_release_evidence
purpose: Collect a fresh compliance evidence snapshot for an existing release.

name: gitlab_list_release_links
purpose: List the downloadable asset links attached to a release.

name: gitlab_get_release_link
purpose: Get one release asset link by id.

name: gitlab_create_release_link
purpose: Attach a downloadable asset link (binary, package, image or runbook) to a release.

name: gitlab_update_release_link
purpose: Change a release asset link's name, URL or link type.

name: gitlab_delete_release_link
purpose: Remove an asset link from a release.

name: gitlab_get_latest_release
purpose: Resolve the project's latest release (or, given a suffix path, an asset under it) without knowing its tag name in advance; the mapper must follow/read the permalink response and project a small summary, not the raw stream.

name: gitlab_download_release_asset
purpose: Download one asset file attached to a release by its direct asset path, size-capped before it reaches the model.

name: gitlab_list_deploy_keys
purpose: List the deploy keys attached to a project.

name: gitlab_get_deploy_key
purpose: Get one of a project's deploy keys by id, including its fingerprint and push permission.

name: gitlab_add_deploy_key
purpose: Add a brand-new deploy key (public key plus title) to a project.

name: gitlab_update_deploy_key
purpose: Rename a deploy key or change its push permission (the response never echoes CanPush back, even on success).

name: gitlab_delete_deploy_key
purpose: Remove a deploy key from a project; GitLab deletes it entirely once no project uses it.

name: gitlab_enable_deploy_key
purpose: Grant a project access to a deploy key that already exists on another project the caller administers, without creating a new key.

name: gitlab_list_deploy_tokens
purpose: List the deploy tokens on a project or a group. Also covers ListForGroupAsync.

name: gitlab_get_deploy_token
purpose: Get one deploy token's metadata by id, on a project or a group. Also covers GetForGroupAsync.

name: gitlab_create_deploy_token
purpose: Create a deploy token on a project or a group; the plaintext password is returned exactly once. Also covers CreateForGroupAsync.

name: gitlab_delete_deploy_token
purpose: Revoke a deploy token immediately, on a project or a group. Also covers DeleteForGroupAsync.

name: gitlab_upload_secure_file
purpose: Upload a new secure file to a project under a unique name; a second upload under the same name is rejected rather than replacing the first.

name: gitlab_get_secure_file
purpose: Get one secure file's metadata - checksum, expiry, and whatever GitLab parsed out of it.

name: gitlab_download_secure_file
purpose: Download a secure file's raw contents, size-capped before it reaches the model; treat the content as a sensitive secret in transit and in any logs.

name: gitlab_delete_secure_file
purpose: Permanently delete a secure file; the contents are unrecoverable afterward.

name: gitlab_get_pages_settings
purpose: Get a project's Pages configuration - serving URL, HTTPS enforcement, canonical domain, current deployment.

name: gitlab_update_pages_settings
purpose: Change a project's Pages configuration; fields left unset keep their current value.

name: gitlab_unpublish_pages
purpose: Take down a project's deployed Pages site; configuration and custom domains survive for a later republish.

name: gitlab_check_pages_access
returns: bool (derived - GitLab answers with an empty 200 or throws)
purpose: Check whether the caller may view a project's Pages site, surfacing the answer as a boolean rather than an exception.

name: gitlab_list_pages_domains
purpose: List the custom domains configured on a project's Pages site, with certificate detail.

name: gitlab_get_pages_domain
purpose: Get one Pages domain's certificate and verification status by hostname.

name: gitlab_update_pages_domain
purpose: Rotate the certificate on an existing Pages domain, or switch it to Let's Encrypt (the hostname itself cannot change).

name: gitlab_delete_pages_domain
purpose: Remove a custom domain from a project's Pages site.

name: gitlab_verify_pages_domain
purpose: Ask GitLab to re-check a Pages domain's DNS verification TXT record right now instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

name: gitlab_update_instance_appearance
purpose: Update instance branding text/toggle fields (title, guidelines, footer message). Image fields (logo, favicon, PWA icon) require a file upload and are out of scope for this tool surface.

name: gitlab_get_instance_settings
purpose: Read the instance-wide application settings.

name: gitlab_update_instance_settings
purpose: Change one or more instance-wide application settings (visibility defaults, timeouts, security toggles); fields left unset keep their current value.

name: gitlab_get_instance_statistics
purpose: Get instance-wide entity counts (projects, users, issues, merge requests, etc.).

name: gitlab_get_instance_metadata
purpose: Get the instance's version, revision and edition; the one call on this client that any authenticated token can make, useful for compatibility checks.

name: gitlab_get_plan_limits
purpose: Read the resource limits (CI job counts, package max file sizes, storage) configured for a billing plan on a self-managed instance.

name: gitlab_update_plan_limits
purpose: Change resource limits for a billing plan; limits left unset keep their current value.

name: gitlab_get_current_license
purpose: Get the license currently activating this self-managed instance, with billable user count.

name: gitlab_list_licenses
purpose: List every license the instance has ever had (bounded). Entries omit the billable-user count; use gitlab_get_license for that.

name: gitlab_get_license
purpose: Get one license by id, including its billable user count.

name: gitlab_activate_license
purpose: Upload and activate a license key on the instance. The key is as sensitive as a token — never log it.

name: gitlab_delete_license
purpose: Delete a license; deleting the active one deactivates Enterprise Edition features on the instance.

name: gitlab_refresh_license_billable_users
purpose: Trigger a recalculation of a license's billable user count.

name: gitlab_delete_license_policy
purpose: Remove a software license policy from a project.

name: gitlab_get_audit_event
purpose: Get one instance audit event by id.

name: gitlab_list_group_audit_events
purpose: List a group's audit log (bounded). Requires the Owner role on the group, or instance administrator access.

name: gitlab_list_system_hooks
purpose: List every system hook registered on the instance (bounded).

name: gitlab_get_system_hook
purpose: Get one system hook by id.

name: gitlab_update_system_hook
purpose: Update a system hook's URL, events or secrets; URL variables and custom headers replace wholesale when supplied.

name: gitlab_delete_system_hook
purpose: Delete a system hook.

name: gitlab_test_system_hook
purpose: Fire a test run of a system hook with mock data.

name: gitlab_list_project_hooks
purpose: List every webhook configured on a project (bounded).

name: gitlab_get_project_hook
purpose: Get one project webhook by id.

name: gitlab_update_project_hook
purpose: Update a project webhook; URL variables and custom headers replace wholesale when supplied.

name: gitlab_delete_project_hook
purpose: Delete a project webhook.

name: gitlab_test_project_hook
purpose: Fire a test delivery of one event type against a project webhook, using mock data (rate-limited to 5/min per user per project).

name: gitlab_resend_project_hook_delivery
purpose: Replay one previously logged webhook delivery, identified by its delivery id.

name: gitlab_list_group_hooks
purpose: List every webhook configured on a group (bounded).

name: gitlab_get_group_hook
purpose: Get one group webhook by id.

name: gitlab_update_group_hook
purpose: Update a group webhook; URL variables and custom headers replace wholesale when supplied.

name: gitlab_delete_group_hook
purpose: Delete a group webhook.

name: gitlab_test_group_hook
purpose: Fire a test delivery of one event type against a group webhook, using mock data (rate-limited to 5/min per user per group).

name: gitlab_resend_group_hook_delivery
purpose: Replay one previously logged group webhook delivery.

name: gitlab_list_project_integrations
purpose: List a project's active third-party integrations (Slack, Jira, Datadog, etc.), bounded.

name: gitlab_get_project_integration
purpose: Get one project integration by slug (e.g. 'jira', 'slack', 'datadog').

name: gitlab_get_group_integration
purpose: Get one group integration by slug.

name: gitlab_set_project_integration
purpose: Create or fully replace a project integration's settings by slug, covering all ~51 GitLab integration types through one generic settings-dictionary call. A PUT is a full replace, not a merge, and GitLab masks credentials out of what it returns — never read-then-write-back without re-supplying every credential field.

name: gitlab_disable_project_integration
purpose: Remove a project's configuration for one integration slug.

name: gitlab_disable_group_integration
purpose: Remove a group's configuration for one integration slug.

name: gitlab_get_google_cloud_setup_script
purpose: Get, as plain text, the shell script that sets up a project's Google Cloud integration, or (when a runner-provisioning target project is given) the script that configures a GCP project for GitLab runner provisioning via GetGoogleCloudRunnerDeploymentSetupScriptAsync.

name: gitlab_exchange_platform_token
purpose: Issue a short-lived JWT scoped to one modular-service audience (e.g. Artifact Registry). Treat the result as a credential — never log or echo it.

name: gitlab_get_ci_job_allowed_agents
purpose: List the GitLab agents for Kubernetes available to the calling CI/CD job token. Only meaningful when this server is authenticated with a job token, not a personal access token.

name: gitlab_list_instance_features
purpose: List every instance-wide Flipper development flag and its current gates. These are GitLab's own development flags, not a project's feature flags.

name: gitlab_list_feature_definitions
purpose: List the catalogue of instance feature definitions (owner, type, milestone, rollout issue).

name: gitlab_set_instance_feature
purpose: Enable, disable, or set a percentage rollout for an instance-wide development flag, creating it if it does not exist.

name: gitlab_delete_instance_feature_gate
purpose: Delete an instance feature's gate, reverting it to its default state.

name: gitlab_list_feature_flags
purpose: List a project's feature flags, newest first (bounded).

name: gitlab_get_feature_flag
purpose: Get one project feature flag by name.

name: gitlab_update_feature_flag
purpose: Rename, toggle, or edit the strategies of a project feature flag.

name: gitlab_delete_feature_flag
purpose: Delete a project feature flag.

name: gitlab_get_feature_flag_settings
purpose: Get the minimum role allowed to change a project's feature flags.

name: gitlab_update_feature_flag_settings
purpose: Set the minimum role allowed to change a project's feature flags. Raising it above the caller's own role locks the caller out of further edits.

name: gitlab_get_feature_flag_user_list
purpose: Get one feature flag user list by its iid.

name: gitlab_create_feature_flag_user_list
purpose: Create a feature flag user list from a comma-separated set of external user IDs, for percentage/user-targeted rollouts.

name: gitlab_update_feature_flag_user_list
purpose: Rename a feature flag user list or wholesale-replace its member IDs (not an append).

name: gitlab_delete_feature_flag_user_list
purpose: Delete a feature flag user list. Fails with a conflict while a strategy still references it.

name: gitlab_list_oauth_applications
purpose: List every instance-wide OAuth application (bounded, administrator only).

name: gitlab_create_oauth_application
purpose: Register a new instance-wide OAuth application. The response's plaintext client secret is shown once — treat it as a credential.

name: gitlab_delete_oauth_application
purpose: Delete an instance-wide OAuth application.

name: gitlab_list_my_oauth_applications
purpose: List OAuth applications the current user has registered for themselves (bounded).

name: gitlab_create_my_oauth_application
purpose: Register a personal OAuth application, e.g. for a CI integration owned by the caller. The response's plaintext secret is shown once.

name: gitlab_delete_my_oauth_application
purpose: Delete one of the current user's own OAuth applications.

name: gitlab_list_broadcast_messages
purpose: List every broadcast message on the instance, active or not (bounded).

name: gitlab_get_broadcast_message
purpose: Get one broadcast message by id.

name: gitlab_create_broadcast_message
purpose: Create an instance-wide broadcast banner or notification, with an optional schedule and target audience.

name: gitlab_update_broadcast_message
purpose: Update a broadcast message; fields left unset keep their current value.

name: gitlab_delete_broadcast_message
purpose: Delete a broadcast message.

name: gitlab_get_sidekiq_metrics
purpose: Get combined Sidekiq queue, worker-process and job-completion metrics for the instance in one call.

name: gitlab_get_sidekiq_queue_metrics
purpose: Get backlog size and latency for every Sidekiq job queue, for targeted queue-health checks.

name: gitlab_delete_sidekiq_queue_jobs
purpose: Delete every job in a Sidekiq queue matching at least one required filter (user, project, job class, etc.); GitLab refuses a request with no filter set to prevent an accidental whole-queue wipe.

name: gitlab_get_service_ping
purpose: Get the full Service Ping payload the instance would submit to GitLab, for reviewing what usage data leaves the instance.

name: gitlab_get_service_ping_metric_definitions
purpose: Download every Service Ping metric definition known to the instance.

name: gitlab_track_usage_events
purpose: Track one or more internal GitLab usage events for product analytics; always calls the batch endpoint, so a single event is just a one-element batch.

name: gitlab_list_background_migrations
purpose: List batched background database migrations on the instance (bounded); checked during and after a major version upgrade.

name: gitlab_get_background_migration
purpose: Get one batched background migration by id, including its progress.

name: gitlab_control_background_migration
purpose: Pause an active batched background migration, or resume a paused one (calls ResumeMigrationAsync for the resume action); GitLab 422s if the migration is not in the required starting state.

name: gitlab_get_background_migration_operation
purpose: Get one batched background operation by id.

name: gitlab_control_background_migration_operation
purpose: Restart a stopped batched background operation, or stop a queued/active/paused one (calls StopOperationAsync for the stop action); GitLab 422s if the operation is not in the required starting state.

name: gitlab_list_pending_migrations
purpose: List every pending (not yet run) Rails database migration for the instance. Despite the name this returns a single JSON payload, not a stream — do not paginate it like a real list.

name: gitlab_mark_migration_applied
purpose: Mark a pending migration, identified by its version timestamp, as successfully applied without running it, so future db:migrate tasks skip it. Use with care — this does not run the migration's actual schema/data change.

name: gitlab_get_api_documentation
purpose: Get the Swagger/OpenAPI description of GitLab's whole API, or of one mounted API area when an area name is given, for introspecting what a specific instance's API surface looks like.

name: gitlab_get_compliance_settings
purpose: Get the instance's centralized security policies (CSP) namespace setting. Requires administrator access.

name: gitlab_update_compliance_settings
purpose: Set the instance's centralized security policies (CSP) namespace. Requires administrator access.

name: gitlab_set_compliance_control_status
purpose: Report a third-party compliance check's pass/fail outcome for one of a project's external control bindings, e.g. from a CI pipeline step.

name: gitlab_get_project_export_status
purpose: Poll whether a scheduled project export has finished and is downloadable.

name: gitlab_import_project_from_git
purpose: Import a repository into an existing project from a plain Git URL.

name: gitlab_import_project_from_github
purpose: Create a new GitLab project by importing a GitHub repository.

name: gitlab_get_project_import_status
purpose: Poll the progress or failure detail of the most recent import into a project.

name: gitlab_get_project_template
purpose: Fetch one template's full body/content by key, to scaffold a new file from it.

name: gitlab_export_group
purpose: Schedule a whole-group file export archive.

name: gitlab_get_group_relations_export_status
purpose: Check the progress of one named relation (issues, labels, ...) or, when no relation is given, every relation of a group's direct-transfer export -- the library documents these as the same operation narrowed by a filter.

name: gitlab_list_bulk_imports
purpose: List direct-transfer (instance-to-instance) migrations visible to the caller, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_get_bulk_import
purpose: Get one migration's overall status and whether it has any failures.

name: gitlab_cancel_bulk_import
purpose: Cancel a running migration; does not roll back what has already been imported.

name: gitlab_list_bulk_import_entity_failures
purpose: List every record a migration entity failed to import -- the complete list a Finished-but-HasFailures migration only samples elsewhere.

name: gitlab_import_github_gists
purpose: Import the caller's GitHub gists into GitLab snippets in the background.

name: gitlab_get_ml_experiment
purpose: Get one experiment by its project-relative id or by its unique name.

name: gitlab_create_ml_run
purpose: Start a new run (candidate) under an experiment, ahead of logging metrics/params to it.

name: gitlab_get_ml_run
purpose: Get one run's info and logged metrics/params/tags by its UUID.

name: gitlab_search_ml_runs
purpose: Search the runs belonging to one or more experiments, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_log_ml_run_data
purpose: Log a batch of metrics and parameters against a run in one call -- the library's own recommended way to flush a training loop instead of many single LogMetric/LogParameter calls.

name: gitlab_update_ml_run
purpose: Mark a run finished/failed/killed and set its end time.

name: gitlab_list_ml_models
purpose: Search the models registered in a project's ML model registry, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_get_ml_model_version
purpose: Resolve one model version by explicit version, by alias (e.g. '1.0.0'), or the latest version when neither is given -- three GitLab endpoints for the same concept, folded into one tool.

name: gitlab_create_ml_model
purpose: Register a new model in a project's ML model registry.

name: gitlab_delete_ml_model
purpose: Permanently delete a registered model by name.

name: gitlab_duo_generate_code_completion
purpose: Get an AI code completion for the code at a cursor position.

name: gitlab_duo_generate_git_command
purpose: Turn a plain-language description into the Git command(s) that do it.

name: gitlab_duo_execute_glql_query
purpose: Run a GitLab Query Language query (the same block embeddable in an issue/wiki page) and get its rows back -- useful for ad-hoc reporting across issues/MRs.

name: gitlab_duo_check_code_suggestions_enabled
purpose: Check whether Code Suggestions is available for a project before wiring up an integration that depends on it.

name: gitlab_start_duo_workflow
purpose: Start a Duo Agent Platform agentic flow against a project or namespace with a stated goal.

name: gitlab_get_duo_workflow
purpose: Get a running or finished flow's current details.

name: gitlab_resume_duo_workflow
purpose: Resume a flow that paused waiting for human approval.

name: gitlab_register_ai_agent_identity
purpose: Idempotently register this coding agent (type + machine fingerprint) against a project before opening a session.

name: gitlab_list_ai_agent_sessions
purpose: List a project's external coding-agent sessions, newest first, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_create_ai_agent_session
purpose: Open a new external agent session under a registered identity, with an idempotency key to make retries safe.

name: gitlab_complete_ai_agent_session
purpose: Close out an agent session as completed or failed.

name: gitlab_list_experiments
purpose: List the A/B experiments configured on the instance, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_get_experiment_assignment
purpose: Look up the cached variant assignment for an experiment and a user/namespace/project context.

name: gitlab_force_experiment_assignment
purpose: Force a specific variant for an experiment and context, e.g. to reproduce a support case.

name: gitlab_list_admin_model_records
purpose: Instance-administrator inspection of an internal data model's records and checksum state, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_get_database_dictionary_table
purpose: Look up which feature category owns a database table, or list every table's dictionary entry for a database when no table name is given.

name: gitlab_ingest_rollout_event
purpose: Report a flow-graph progress event for a CD rollout from a custom orchestrator, and get the rollout's current state back.

name: gitlab_list_jira_forge_subscriptions
purpose: Audit which GitLab namespaces the GitLab-for-Jira (Forge) installation can currently see, bounded by limit.

name: gitlab_delete_jira_forge_subscription
purpose: Revoke one namespace's subscription to the Jira Forge installation, cutting off its development-data flow to Jira.

name: gitlab_register_mobile_push_subscription
purpose: Register a device token for GitLab mobile push notifications.

name: gitlab_unregister_mobile_push_subscription
purpose: Remove a device token's push subscription.
